NPT-4011                                                                                                                    about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 27-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  APPLIED ACCELERATED ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE [NPT-4011]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)              Explain the difference between supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning,  
  providing an example application for each.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Discuss the steps followed in k means clustering algorithm.                                (5)  
  2)              Describe the ABCD formula for melanoma diagnosis and discuss how optimization  
  techniques can improve its diagnostic accuracy.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Explain the concept of synthetic skin lesions in medical research and discuss how they  
  are generated for training diagnostic models.                                              (5)  
  
  3)              Discuss the strategies used for multiclass classification implementations.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Discuss Naive bayes algorithm briefly.                                                     (5)  
  4)              Compare conventional smear and liquid based cytology.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Discuss support vector machine briefly.                                                    (5)  
  5)              Discuss words sense disambiguation with a relevant example.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Discuss the role of recommending self-care activities in intelligent personal health  
  record.                                                                                    (5)  
  
  
  -----End-----
